title: Troubleshooting: Beige Fee and Balance Issues
summary: This document troubleshoots Beige account monthly maintenance fee ($200) and balance threshold issues. It covers the $500,000 waiver balance threshold, $250,000 minimum balance requirement, domestic out-of-network ATM fee ($0.00), and foreign ATM fee (1% of withdrawal amount with a $2.00 minimum), plus how to verify periods, timestamps, transfers, and dual authorization.
faqs: Why did I get charged the $200 monthly maintenance fee if I expected the waiver?
Does meeting the $250,000 minimum balance also waive the Beige monthly maintenance fee?
What could cause my Beige balance to dip below the $250,000 minimum unexpectedly?
How do I troubleshoot an ATM fee discrepancy for domestic vs. foreign transactions?
If a foreign ATM fee looks wrong, how should it be recalculated using 1% with a $2.00 minimum?
What information should I collect before requesting a review of Beige fee or balance issues?
keywords: Balance measurement vs period cut-off timestamps
Request a review: statement period, balance history, transfer logs
